newsitem.title: USA: Bethlehem Steel considers new rolling mill.
newsitem.headline: Bethlehem Steel considers new rolling mill.

text.p: Bethlehem Steel Corp said Tuesday it is considering the possible construction of a new cold rolling mill which could be either on-site at Sparrows Point or at another location.

The consideration was noted in the company's report of first quarter earnings which quoted chief executive Curtis Barnette as said "we continue to advance plans for profitably growing our business through selective modernization, joint ventures and other actions."
After the company's annual meeting, he said the objective of a new mill would be "to make Sparrows Point competitive."

When asked if Bethlehem would build the mill on its own, Barnette said "our present discussions have been that bethlehem construct and operate it," but the company has not ruled out building the mill in a joint venture with another steelmaker.

"We are developing plans and implementing actions to further improve the profitability of the entire corporation through a wide range of competitiveness initiatives including enhancing customer service and reliability, improving productivity, aggressively reducing costs and, where appropriate, undertaking selected modernization projects," the company's explained in its statment.
Bethlehem also said operations have started at the company's Chicago Cold Rolling joint venture in Indiana which produces light-gauge cold-rolled sheet for the appliance and other specialty markets.
